data.body: [operator-attested] Evidence for the two remaining ACs: (AC-19) tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py, merged to main in 39de64871c (change 1781) — test_fsck_default_skips_archived_and_flag_restores asserts default fsck does not visit archived tickets and --include-archived restores the full walk; test_ticket_dirs_defaults_to_active_only asserts the shared _ticket_dirs iterator excludes archived by default and includes with include_archived=True; sibling tests cover the compact-all sweep both ways. (AC-20) comment on e72e-259d-5ee7-4e73 records the compact.trigger=off mitigation removal — verified no compact.trigger key in ~/.config/rebar/config.toml nor .rebar configs; .rebar/compact-sweep.stamp shows sweeps running at defaults post-1763.
